title: A size bound implies polynomial size
statement: Let $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a well-formed circuit family with fan-in at most two and size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$, and there are natural numbers $a,k$ such that $T(n) \le a(n+1)^k$ for every $n$, then $L$ has polynomial circuit size with fan-in at most two.
